types.name: Generations, history and types of computers
types.description: Asks which generation used a technology (vacuum tube, transistor, IC, microprocessor), who invented a machine, or names a class of computer (super, mainframe, mini, micro, laptop).

types.name: CPU, registers and booting
types.description: Names a CPU part (ALU, CU), a register (PC, IR, MAR, MDR, accumulator) or a step of starting the computer (POST, BIOS, cold or warm boot).

types.name: Primary memory and the memory hierarchy
types.description: Asks about RAM, ROM, cache or registers: volatile or not, SRAM vs DRAM, PROM/EPROM/EEPROM, or which memory is fastest.

types.name: Secondary storage devices
types.description: Asks about hard disks, SSDs, CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray, pen drives or magnetic tape: their type (magnetic, optical, flash), capacity or access method.

types.name: Data units, bit rate and address lines
types.description: Converts between bits, bytes, KB, MB, GB and TB, or asks how many address lines a memory of a given size needs.

types.name: Input and output devices, ports and printers
types.description: Asks whether a device is input or output, what MICR/OCR/OMR do, which printer is impact or non-impact, or what a port (serial, parallel, USB, VGA, HDMI) does.

types.name: Number system conversions
types.description: Gives a number in binary, octal, decimal or hexadecimal and asks for it in another base.
